name: Frontpoint
description: Home security company founded in 2007 selling DIY-installed, customizable alarm systems with professional monitoring, known for customer service and contract-based monitoring plans sold direct to US and Canadian households.

evidence.summary: Frontpoint's own Consumer Affiliate Program (CAP) agreement, effective July 29, 2024, confirms an in-house program that lets affiliates monetize websites, social media user-generated content, emails and apps with unique QR codes, URLs and referral codes; commission is paid on qualified actions (a new customer who signs a monitoring agreement, installs, activates and stays at least 30 days).

FindAffiliates' November 2026 check of Frontpoint's current brand page states commission varies based on contract term; older directories list flat amounts ($175 per sale on Lasso, $300+ per activation elsewhere) that no longer match the brand's published position, so commission_rate is recorded as null.

The program invites creators, bloggers and influencers but its eligibility section looks for a public, established social following; no absolute creator counts are published, so creator_saturation is recorded as unknown.

opportunity.title: Frontpoint Consumer Affiliate Program — in-house; commission varies by contract term

reasons.niche_fit: DIY monitored alarm systems fit smart-home and home-safety creator content well.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The CAP terms explicitly name social media user-generated content as a monetizable channel.
reasons.compensation: Rate left null: the brand's current page says commission varies by contract term and older flat-rate listings conflict.
reasons.contact_access: Public program terms and an application route on the brand's own site; no published program email found.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application asks for a social or website URL and the brand looks for an established public following, which limits smaller creators.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2007 with a long track record in US home security.
